motion_narrative: Precision spring physics conveying spatial clarity and tactile momentum, avoiding gratuitous ornament.

library_selection.rationale: Motion for React provides hardware-accelerated spring animations, full exit transitions, and < 35KB footprint without requiring heavy external GSAP/Lenis bundles.

interaction_contracts.purpose: Provide tactile visual confirmation on link/button hover
interaction_contracts.expected_behavior: Element scales subtly (1.02) with border highlight transition
interaction_contracts.visual_feedback: Border transitions to primary cyan token over 150ms
interaction_contracts.accessibility_fallback: Standard CSS border highlight on focus-visible

interaction_contracts.purpose: Reveal project dossier details on selection
interaction_contracts.expected_behavior: Accordion or detail pane expands smoothly using Motion layout animation
interaction_contracts.visual_feedback: Content opacity and height transition in 250ms
interaction_contracts.accessibility_fallback: Instantaneous DOM visibility change when reduced motion is preferred

reduced_motion_contract.replacement_behavior: All transitions become instantaneous opacity fades or static state switches (0ms duration).

performance_budget.test_environment: Chrome Headless, 60Hz display, simulated mid-tier CPU

escalation_policy.fallback_action: Disable spring physics and use pure CSS transform transitions
